rows.title: Soft French crop with scissor sides
rows.reason: Your straight hair and average forehead make this softer crop very wearable, with enough width at the sides to keep an oval face looking natural.
rows.tell: I'd like a soft French crop with scissor sides, and please leave the crown slightly longer so it doesn't pop up.

rows.title: Messy fringe
rows.reason: Your straight medium-density hair wants to fall forward, so this messy fringe works naturally and softens the front without overbuilding height.
rows.tell: I want a messy textured fringe with a low taper, but leave extra length through the crown so it doesn't stick up.

rows.title: Textured French crop with low taper
rows.reason: Your hair already pushes forward well, so this textured crop is an easy match that frames the forehead cleanly without needing much styling.
rows.tell: Give me a textured French crop with a low taper and keep the top pushed forward with natural texture.

rows.title: Short curtains with low taper
rows.reason: Your oval face can wear the width from short curtains easily, and your straight hair helps the split front sit clean without looking heavy.
rows.tell: I want short curtains with a low taper, but keep the crown longer and the front split soft.

rows.title: Soft side part
rows.reason: Your medium strand thickness can hold a gentle side part well, and this version adds clean shape without making the style look too stiff.
rows.tell: I'd like a soft side part with scissor-cut sides, and keep the crown longer so it sits smoothly.

rows.title: Textured fringe
rows.reason: Your forward growth and current top length suit a textured fringe shape that looks easy and keeps the overall silhouette balanced.
rows.tell: Give me a textured fringe with a low taper and keep the crown a bit longer so the back lays flatter.

rows.title: Mod cut
rows.reason: Your forward-growing straight hair suits the direction of a mod shape, and the fuller sides would frame your face in a stylish way.
rows.tell: I want a mod-inspired cut with fuller scissor-cut sides and a forward textured shape on top.

rows.title: Ivy League
rows.reason: Your straight hair and average features suit an Ivy League well, especially if you want something tidy that still has a bit of shape on top.
rows.tell: Give me an Ivy League with a low taper, but leave the crown slightly longer and not too stiff on top.

rows.title: Side-swept textured crop
rows.reason: Your density can support a side-swept crop nicely, and the lighter side movement gives your oval face shape without feeling too formal.
rows.tell: Give me a side-swept textured crop, but leave extra length at the crown so it stays controlled.

rows.title: Korean two-block with curtain fringe
rows.reason: Your straight hair can support the clean separation of a Korean two block, and the curtain front gives flattering width across an oval face.
rows.tell: Give me a Korean two block with a soft curtain fringe, and leave the crown longer so it stays smooth.

rows.title: Two block taper
rows.reason: Two block taper is a two-block cut with a tucked-in undercut and movement on top, and your hair already grows forward, so the front lies down without a fight.

rows.title: Two block fade
rows.reason: Two block fade is a two-block cut with a tucked-in undercut and movement on top, and your hair already grows forward, so the front lies down without a fight.

rows.title: Center part Korean
rows.reason: Center part Korean keeps the sides soft and scissor-cut instead of clippered tight, and the curtain split lets the front cowlick part where it wants to.

rows.title: E-boy curtains
rows.reason: E-boy curtains is a curtain cut, parted in the middle and falling to both sides, and the curtain split lets the front cowlick part where it wants to.

rows.title: Two block long fringe
rows.reason: Two block long fringe fades the sides in at mid height for a clear but gentle contrast, and the choppy front breaks up the front cowlick so it never stands out.

rows.title: Ear tuck
rows.reason: Ear tuck keeps the sides soft and scissor-cut instead of clippered tight, and a crown cowlick has little room to stand up at this height.
